issues.detail: The Vietnamese text begins with 'Đức Giê-hô-va phán:' ('The LORD said:') which is not present in the Hebrew verse. This is an added clause that changes the framing of the verse.

The Hebrew has 'תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר' (Tiglath-pileser) and 'אַשּׁוּר' (Assyria), but the Vietnamese renders 'Tít-lát-bi-lé-xe' and 'A-đu' — 'A-đu' appears to be a transliteration error or substitution for 'Assyria' (A-đu is not a standard Vietnamese rendering of Assyria; it should be 'A-si-ri' or similar). This is a name swap/error.
The Hebrew has 'הַגִּלְעָד' (Gilead), but the Vietnamese renders 'Gi-lean' which is not a standard transliteration of Gilead (should be 'Ga-la-át' or 'Ghi-lê-át'). This is a name error.
The Hebrew has 'נַפְתָּלִי' (Naphtali), but the Vietnamese renders 'Na-phtha-li' — this is a minor transliteration issue but still a name error (should be 'Náp-ta-li' or similar).
